subject.title: Cross-provider fallback should respect provider trust boundaries for images/attachments

question: Should cross-provider fallback treat images and attachments as separately trusted media, and what default should existing users get on upgrade?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing between compatibility, fail-closed privacy, and an explicit trust knob changes the product security boundary and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add explicit media trust policy
options.body: Preserve the current default for compatibility, then add a documented config surface and tests so users can restrict cross-provider images and attachments.

options.title: Fail closed on cross-provider media
options.body: Strip images and prompt-detected media whenever fallback crosses providers, accepting that existing multimodal fallback setups may lose context after upgrade.

options.title: Document configured fallback as consent
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and make docs state that configured fallback providers may receive the same media payloads as the primary provider.

recommendation.title: Add explicit media trust policy
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default for compatibility, then add a documented config surface and tests so users can restrict cross-provider images and attachments.
